title: Look-Back Window of the Late Fee Review
content:
The review look-back of an Apartment Home Lease late fee review follows the renewals recorded on the lease's Lease Term Agreements: two or more renewal rent changes give a look-back of the last 6 months, exactly one gives the last 9 months, and none gives the last 12 months. The last N months means dated after the same day of the month N months before the handling date.

**What the look-back measures.** It is the window within which another billing period's initial late fee line counts as an earlier late period.

**Records read.** The rent change records on the customer's Lease Term Agreements for the lease, counting those whose reason is a renewal.

| Renewal rent changes on the Lease Term Agreements | Review look-back |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | last 6 months |
| exactly 1 | last 9 months |
| none | last 12 months |

## Window dates (hypothetical handling date 18 October 2026)

| Look-back | Initial late fee lines counted if dated |
|---|---|
| last 6 months | after 18 April 2026 |
| last 9 months | after 18 January 2026 |
| last 12 months | after 18 October 2025 |

*Example (hypothetical):* another period's initial late fee line dated 2 March 2026 counts as an earlier late period for a lease with one renewal rent change (9-month look-back) but not for a lease with two or more (6-month look-back).
